Real Madrid's Rüdiger Says Spain's Team Play Is the Difference
videos.description: Real Madrid and Germany defender Antonio Rüdiger joins Christina Ruffini and Bloomberg News Senior Sports Reporter Randall Williams on Bloomberg This Weekend and says Spain's teamwork and possession make it a formidable opponent ahead of the World Cup final against Argentina, while praising Lionel Messi's enduring impact on the game. Rüdiger also reflected on player longevity, promoted his foundation supporting children in Sierra Leone and said he opposes expanding the World Cup to 64 teams. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: Can Big Tech’s AI Spending Pay Off?
videos.description: Centerview Partners co-founder Blair Effron says AI is moving markets more than it’s moving most corporate boardrooms, with roughly $700 billion in hyperscaler capex raising pressure to prove returns. He says CEOs are investing, but adoption outside tech remains slower than investors assume, while higher costs, consumer pressure and the need for scale are driving caution across the C-suite. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: Dinosaur Fossils Become Wealth Market's New Trophy Asset
videos.description: Bloomberg News Wealth Reporter Devon Pendleton joins Christina Ruffini on Bloomberg This Weekend to discuss how rare dinosaur fossils have become a fast-growing collectible market, with wealthy buyers spending tens of millions of dollars on museum-quality specimens while demanding detailed provenance to verify authenticity. As auction houses expand the market, collectors are drawn by the rarity, scientific significance and cultural appeal of iconic dinosaurs such as Tyrannosaurus rex and Stegosaurus. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
